en: I will go forth when You say I will stop if it's not Your Will

ko: 나의 가고 서는 것 주님 뜻에 있으니
en: It depends on Your Will, whether I will go or stop O Lord God, please lead me to your way

ko: 뜻하신 그 곳에 나 있기 원합니다
en: Where you want me to be, I wan to be there with you I will obey your command and will live as you lead me
Even with my weak soul, may you work through me For the sake of the Lord's Kingdom and His Will O Lord God, please lead me to Your Way
